question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2023 Q6d(i/ii) — Po-210 Alpha Decay and Half-Life Nuclei Count
question.text:
(i) A polonium-210 nucleus decays by alpha-particle emission to a lead (Pb) nucleus. Complete the equation: ²¹⁰₈₄Po → [?] + [?] (3 marks)

(ii) Polonium-210 has a half-life of 138 days. A sample contains 6.4 × 10⁶ polonium nuclei. Calculate the number of polonium nuclei remaining after 552 days. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q6d(i) — Alpha decay equation:

²¹⁰₈₄Po → ²⁰⁶₈₂Pb + ⁴₂α

Mass number: 210 = A + 4 → A = 206

Atomic number: 84 = Z + 2 → Z = 82 (Lead = Pb, Z = 82)

Q6d(ii) — Remaining nuclei after 552 days:

Number of half-lives: n = 552 / 138 = 4

N = N₀ × (½)ⁿ = 6.4 × 10⁶ × (½)⁴ = 6.4 × 10⁶ / 16 = 4.0 × 10⁵ nuclei
